prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated Stone Age game item sprite. Attached props and camp scene are locked style anchors: closely match their fine selective dark ink contours, sparse interior linework, two-tone upper-left illumination and restrained natural wash. Use muted neutral earth browns, grays and quiet accents, avoid intense yellow-orange saturation. Camera strictly vertically overhead orthographic, only slight front-face cheat. Uniform solid pure #FF00FF magenta backdrop everywhere outside object including gaps. Center single compact object with margin, readily readable at 48-64px. No ground apron, decorative scatter, cast shadow, text, labels, people, photo, 3D, isometric perspective, pixel art, gradient blur, modern objects or metal. Subject: medium orderly pile of seven short rough bark logs.
